searchMode.title: Search Mode
searchMode.description: Choose how to search: provide a direct listing URL, or use category/filter search

startUrl.title: TractorHouse URL
startUrl.description: Direct URL from TractorHouse.com search results or category page (e.g., https://www.tractorhouse.com/listings/farm-equipment/for-sale/list/category/1092/tractors)

manufacturer.title: Manufacturer/Brand
manufacturer.description: Filter by equipment manufacturer (leave empty for all brands)
manufacturer.example: John Deere, Case IH, New Holland, Kubota, Massey Ferguson

yearMin.title: Minimum Year
yearMin.description: Minimum manufacturing year (leave empty for no minimum)

yearMax.title: Maximum Year
yearMax.description: Maximum manufacturing year (leave empty for no maximum)

priceMin.title: Minimum Price (USD)
priceMin.description: Minimum price in USD (leave empty for no minimum)

priceMax.title: Maximum Price (USD)
priceMax.description: Maximum price in USD (leave empty for no maximum)

location.title: Location (State/Province)
location.description: Filter by US state or Canadian province (e.g., Iowa, Nebraska, Ontario)

zipCode.title: Zip/Postal Code
zipCode.description: Search near a specific zip or postal code

searchRadius.title: Search Radius (miles)
searchRadius.description: Search radius from zip code in miles (requires zipCode)

horsepowerMin.title: Minimum Horsepower
horsepowerMin.description: Minimum horsepower (for tractors and powered equipment)

horsepowerMax.title: Maximum Horsepower
horsepowerMax.description: Maximum horsepower (for tractors and powered equipment)

maxResults.title: Maximum Results
maxResults.description: Maximum number of listings to scrape
